summary: The agent helped the customer link Aadhaar to savings account.

intents.keywords: Hello, I want to know how to link my Aadhaar...branch help me.

issues.issue: Difficulty linking Aadhaar to savings account.
issues.reason(s): Customer unable to get assistance at the branch and unfamiliar with online processes.

intents.actions of agent: Offered to guide the customer, provided options for branch visit or online form submission, and offered assistance with filling out the form.
intents.Process Request: Agent will send a simple form to the customer's registered email address.
intents.resolution: Agent will send a form to the customer's email to link Aadhaar to the savings account.
